verdict.rationale: Qodo's governance docs, aimed at engineering leaders, promise a complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health, plus insight across repositories. That points to an org-level findings view, though no dashboard is actually described. Acceptance-rate metrics and review-coverage reporting are never documented. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard documentation, acceptance/dismissal-rate analytics, org-wide review coverage metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
